articles.author: Sarah Perez
articles.title: Google gives publishers a new way to fight AI-driven traffic losses - TechCrunch
articles.description: Google is giving publishers a new button that lets readers make them a preferred source across Search, Discover, and Google News, potentially boosting their traffic as AI search sends fewer clicks to the web.
articles.content: As AI continues to kill traffic to websites, Google on Thursday threw a bone to those publishers negatively impacted by the change. It’s now allowing readers to push a button on a publisher’s website… [+2253 chars]
